answers.reason: The description does not include research associates as members of the senate.
The budget planning round involves office holders of higher rank, not research associates.
Appointment committees deal with professorships and do not include research associates.
The faculty council is led by the dean, and research associates are not listed as members.
Study commissions handle faculty teaching matters without including research associates.
Examination boards decide on student matters without research associate membership.
Internal research funding rounds are handled at the faculty level without research associate participation.
Module revision working groups are not specified to include research associates.
Laboratory equipment procurement is outside the stated duties of a research associate.
Orientation week planning is for new students and does not involve research associates as participants.
